svg.title: Operational transformation: two concurrent edits to "abc" applied as sent, then transformed
svg.desc: Both editors start with abc. Alice inserts X at position 1 and sees aXbc. Bob deletes position 2, the c, and sees ab. Applying each other's operation as sent: Alice deletes position 2 of aXbc, which is b, giving aXc; Bob inserts X at 1 of ab, giving aXb; the documents diverge. Transformed: Bob's delete at 2 becomes delete at 3 on Alice's side because her insert at 1 shifted it, giving aXb; Alice's insert at 1 is before 2 and stays at 1 on Bob's side, giving aXb; they converge.
svg.text: without transform: apply the other's op as sent
with transform: shift past what you already applied
